question: In an election, two candidates were against each other. One candidate received 44% votes and lost the election by 7488 votes. How many votes did the winner receive?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Winner's vote percentage = 100% − 44% = 56%

Difference in vote percentages = 56% − 44% = 12%

Since the margin is 7488 votes, 12% → 7488

Winner's votes (56%) = (7488 ÷ 12) × 56

⇒ 624 × 56 = 34944

**∴ The correct answer is 34944 votes.**
